notes.text: Required for the activation of Rho-associated protein kinases ROCK1 and ROCK2 and promotes epithelial-mesenchymal transition (PubMed:27399334). Enhances the activation of phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase (PI3K) by binding simultaneously to the catalytic and regulatory subunits (PubMed:32606397). This relieves the inhibitory effect of the regulatory subunit on the kinase activity of the catalytic subunit, resulting in downstream signaling events such as AKT activation, GSK3B inactivation, and increased levels of SNAI1 (PubMed:32606397). Promotes glycolysis by binding to the pyruvate kinase PKM homotetramer to form a heterooctamer, inhibiting PKM activity (PubMed:33314660). Promotes the IMP4-mediated nuclear translocation of both PKM and the NF-kappa-B complex which increases transcription of VEGFA, leading to increased angiogenesis (PubMed:33314660)

Interacts with Rho-associated protein kinases ROCK1 and ROCK2; the interaction promotes ROCK activation (PubMed:27399334). Interacts with phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunits PIK3CA/p110alpha, PIK3CB/p110beta and PIK3CD/p110delta (via the catalytic domain) as well as with non-catalytic regulatory subunit PIK3R1/p85a; binds to the catalytic and regulatory subunits simultaneously which relieves the inhibitory effect of the regulatory subunit on the kinase activity of the catalytic subunit (PubMed:32606397). Interacts with pyruvate kinase PKM isoform M2 (PKM2); binds to the PKM2 homotetramer to form a heterooctamer, consisting of the PKM2 homotetramer with 4 copies of FOXM1, which reduces PKM2 activity, leading to promotion of glycolysis (PubMed:33314660). Interacts with the NFKB1/p50 and RELA/p65 subunits of the NF-kappa-B transcription factor complex; this promotes their nuclear translocation along with PKM2, leading to increased VEGFA transcription and angiogenesis (PubMed:33314660). Interacts with VPS11; the interaction promotes exosome-mediated release of VEGFA (PubMed:33314660)
